text: P174677 - Nicaragua COVID-19 Education Sector Response Project (closed 2022-10-31). Five matching public records, oldest first by document date:
5. 2023-04-27 - Implementation Completion and Results Report (ICR6217), disclosed 2023-04-28. http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099042723124529199
All three requested types are available. The project's other public records (ISRs, ESCPs, an ICR Review and others) were not requested.

right_sources: Filters by project ID P174677 and the three document types; returns the PAD, all three procurement plans and the ICR.
grounded: Dates, report numbers and links match the records; nothing is added that the project does not have.
complete: All five records, in ascending document-date order, with a link each.
scoped: Orders by document date (and does not confuse it with disclosure date, e.g. the PAD was disclosed 2021-02-02, after the first plan); says whether each requested type was found.
